description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Auton Soldier.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Auton Soldier and another permanent you control.
Activate Auton Soldier by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Auton Soldier
uses.cardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness
